current_ORGI_platform_context.observation: ORGI states that Census tables are distributed as Excel files through Census Tables/Digital Library and that most table content is also available through its API.
current_ORGI_platform_context.promotion_boundary: platform capability/context only; no numeric value is promoted without exact source-cell verification

deduplication.canonicalization_action: Treat catalogue page, direct-download endpoint, Census Tables listing and API representation as manifestations/interfaces of the same underlying ORGI resource identity where identifiers match; do not inflate source counts.
deduplication.reason_count_neutral: Existing controlled source totals already include ORGI/Census source families and the 73 unresolved WEB-MUN leads are not fully dispositioned.

blocked_attempts.observation: Direct PDF open returned a transient 502 during page-render verification; screenshot resolution could therefore not be completed in this run.
blocked_attempts.disposition: Record the exact first-party download identity only, keep page/image/OCR verification open, and continue safe independent streams.
